fact: SeyID supports online eKYC onboarding, one-time passwords, passwordless QR-code login via the SeyID mobile app and document signing, and its e-wallet stores the national ID with a QR code for third-party verification such as opening a bank account (WISeKey, 22 April 2024).
title: WISeKey Awarded Project by Government of Seychelles to Deliver "SeyID", a Digital Identity Platform
